column1: # The function-quality audit ledger — the coverage half of docs PNB/PLAN.md §3.3.
# One row per .c file in src/, no exceptions. tools/guardrails.sh checks this list
# against the tree, so a file can never be silently skipped: a new .c file has to be
# classified here before `make guardrails` passes again. PLAN.md §3.3 keeps the audit
# standard and the findings register; this file keeps the coverage.
#   audited   read against the four §3.3 questions; findings recorded in PLAN.md §3.3
#   open      not audited yet, and nothing blocks auditing it
#   deferred  a scheduled slice rewrites or deletes the file, so auditing it now is
#             churn — the audit is part of THAT slice's exit criteria instead
